rules.message: Dapper sends a list as one array parameter on Npgsql. 'IN @ids' then fails with 42601.
rules.fix: Write '= ANY(@ids)' and pass an array or a list.

rules.message: SELECT * does not return system columns. On an entity with an xmin token, EF fails with 42703.
rules.fix: Select the columns and the token: 'SELECT o.*, o.xmin FROM orders AS o'. Ignore the warning with a reason when the entity has no xmin token.
nomatch: db.Orders.FromSql($"SELECT o.*, o.xmin FROM orders AS o")

rules.message: 'timestamp' has no time zone. An instant in it loses its meaning, and now() is converted to the session zone.
rules.fix: Use timestamptz for instants, and send UTC values. Keep timestamp only for a local wall-clock value, with a suppression comment.
nomatch: PlacedAt = table.Column<DateTimeOffset>(type: "timestamp with time zone", nullable: false)

rules.message: serial is the old form of an identity column. It has a separate sequence with other rights and ownership.
rules.fix: Use 'bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY', or a uuid key (DATA-07).
nomatch: id bigint GENERATED ALWAYS AS IDENTITY PRIMARY KEY,

rules.message: One NULL in the subquery makes NOT IN return no rows.
rules.fix: Write NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ... WHERE ... = outer.column).
match: WHERE sku NOT IN (SELECT sku FROM discontinued)
where id not in ( select order_id from x)
nomatch: WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM discontinued d WHERE d.sku = s.sku)

rules.message: A new NpgsqlConnection from a connection string in each call spreads the pool settings and the type mappings (DATA-23).
rules.fix: Register one NpgsqlDataSource (AddNpgsqlDataSource) and call OpenConnectionAsync on it.
match: await using var connection = new NpgsqlConnection(cs);
nomatch: await using var connection = await dataSource.OpenConnectionAsync(ct);

match: CREATE INDEX CONCURRENTLY ix_order_lines_sku ON order_lines (sku);
nomatch: ALTER TABLE orders ADD COLUMN note text;

match: await using var writer = await connection.BeginBinaryImportAsync(sql, ct);
